_note: Beth loot phase 2: equippable hero gear. PROPOSED values. value = shop list price in gold; sell = what a merchant pays (30%). Tiers: 1 common (iron, sold in towns), 2 rare (steel, port smiths/limited stock + drops), 3 epic (named, boss/elite drops and chests only; not sold).

perk.name: Brine-Edge
perk.desc: Heal 6% of damage dealt.

perk.name: Riposte
perk.desc: After a perfect block, the next hit deals 150% and always crits.

perk.name: Mercy Stroke
perk.desc: Hits on non-boss enemies under 15% HP kill them outright; bosses take +30% instead.

perk.name: Ember Bite

perk.name: Hallowed Ring
perk.desc: Staggering an enemy heals the party 3% max HP.

perk.name: Tidebreaker

perk.name: Starfall
perk.desc: Skill cooldowns -15%; every 5th skill cast is free.

perk.name: Winter Harvest
perk.desc: Kills restore 20% SP and chill nearby enemies.

perk.name: Wyrmglass Arrow
perk.desc: +40% crit damage; crits ricochet to a 2nd target.

perk.name: Stormbolt
perk.desc: Bolts chain lightning to 3 nearby enemies.

perk.name: Ballad of the Tide
perk.desc: Party +12% ATK while Cedric plays; nearby allies regen 1% HP/s.

perk.name: Coilbind
perk.desc: Lash roots enemies for 2.5 s (bosses: 40% slow).

perk.name: Furnace Fists
perk.desc: Each hit in a combo adds +5% damage (max +50%) and the 10th hit explodes.

perk.name: Warden's Sight
perk.desc: +12% crit and enemies' weak points glow.

perk.name: Rimeguard
perk.desc: Immune to frost slow and freeze; +30% frost resist.

perk.name: Dread of the Vale
perk.desc: +25% poise; when hit, 10% chance to make the attacker cower for 1.5 s.

perk.name: Starsilk Ward
perk.desc: Every 20 s, a shield absorbs damage up to 20% max HP.

perk.name: Watchman's Reflex
perk.desc: Perfect dodges heal 4% max HP and refund 15 SP.

perk.name: Thornplate
perk.desc: Reflect 25% of melee damage taken; frost resist +30%.

perk.name: Seawall
perk.desc: Blocks reflect 40% of the blocked damage; can block boss slams.

perk.name: Seal of the Deep
perk.desc: Crits heal 2% max HP.

perk.name: Last Light
perk.desc: Once per in-game day, survive a killing blow at 30% HP.

perk.name: Bonded Spirit
perk.desc: Companion takes 20% of the leader's damage and never despawns.
